calibration_partition.scheme: group-disjoint cross-fit: fit on one side, score Brier on the other, both directions weighted by evaluated rows; the chosen method is refitted on all rows afterwards

conformal_partition.scheme: direction-symmetric split-conformal over the group split: each side's declared quantile is computed with the other side held out, the larger factor ships, and the recorded coverage is measured on the family side that did not produce the shipped factor

group_cv.label_source: tools/risk_validation.reconstruct_families: pinned public selection metadata (AIME, DeepMind Mathematics) plus deterministic prompt-content rules on the materialized public inputs
